import contextlib
import importlib.util
import pathlib
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
tempfile.tempdir = str(root / 'test-temp')
pathlib.Path(tempfile.tempdir).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'scripts'))
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('b_tests', root/'sim/feedback/test_residual_overflow_tool.py')
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
names = [
    'EncodingGateTest.test_float_positive_full_scale_is_not_turned_into_negative_rail',
    'EncodingGateTest.test_float_out_of_range_is_rejected',
    'EncodingGateTest.test_float_dtype_pcm_field_is_rejected',
    'EncodingGateTest.test_declared_q20_hash_mismatch_stops_attribution',
    'EncodingGateTest.test_declared_q20_hash_match_keeps_attribution',
    'EncodingGateTest.test_frame_domain_mismatch_is_rejected',
    'EncodingGateTest.test_whole_and_valid_are_reported_separately',
    'AnalyzeTest.test_history_prefix_is_excluded',
]
out = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
with out.open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as stream:
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(stream), contextlib.redirect_stderr(stream):
        suite = unittest.TestSuite(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames(names, mod))
        result = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stream, verbosity=2).run(suite)
print('B named: %d run, %d failures, %d errors' % (result.testsRun, len(result.failures), len(result.errors)))
sys.exit(not result.wasSuccessful())
